Messages.Author: galliard
Messages.Body:
Hi, i was wondering, how his :ignore excess over 2 damage" work? Please anybody capable answering. Does it work like Flesh of Marble or rather ignore excess hits first, then you can prevent after.
On example, lets say our remnant has 2 Flak Jackets and is hit y Shambling Horde for 4 damage.
Does he receive 2 damage or zero?
regards

Messages.Author: KevinM
Messages.Body:
Remnant of the Endless Storm
Ally
6 pool
Unique werewolf with 5 life. 1 strength, 0 bleed. Requires a magaji.
The Remnant gets +1 strength for each life it has. The Remnant may enter combat with any minion as a  action. If any effect does more than 2 damage to the Remnant, ignore the excess. If the Remnant has 4 or fewer life during your untap phase, it gains 1 life from the blood bank.

So:
"ignore the excess" is a short way of saying "ignore the rest of the damage from the effect."

Messages.Author: galliard
Messages.Body:
I appreciate you reply very much, but it doesnt really answer my question
To make it easier - will it be 2 or 0 damage in my example?
take care

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
SH inflict to Remnant 4 damage.
If you prevent no damage using the Flak etc., it takes 4 damage that exceeds 2, so it ends taking 2 damage.
If you prevent 1 damage using the Flak etc., it takes 3 damage that exceeds 2, so it ends taking 2 damage.
If you prevent 2 damage using the Flak etc., it takes 2 damage (no excess is ignored).

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
